name: cacaduu-pos-sync-agent
description: Standalone Electron POS export agent with optional CACADUU Cloud Connection

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run native:electron && electron .
scripts.test: npm run native:node && npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.cjs
scripts.smoke:electron: npm run build && npm run native:electron && electron . --smoke-test
scripts.test:electron: npm run build && npm run native:electron && node scripts/test-electron.cjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src ui tests scripts package.json tsconfig.json playwright.config.cjs .github/workflows/desktop.yml
